subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should this stay as the canonical reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode report until live current-main multi-account reaction proof is captured, or should maintainers consolidate it into a broader Socket Mode delivery/liveness item?
rationale: Current source proves handler-level support, but the reported zero-envelope failure cannot be localized without live Slack evidence, and the related open reports do not yet preserve the same reaction-specific reproduction detail.

options.title: Keep reaction-specific report
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical reaction add/remove Socket Mode failure and request redacted live current-main envelope plus gateway trace proof before coding.

options.title: Consolidate into broad Socket Mode report
options.body: Close or redirect only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89222 gains public diagnostics that cover reaction events specifically.

options.title: Fold into liveness work
options.body: Treat it as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77249 only if live evidence shows the Socket Mode connection stalls for all event families, not reactions alone.

recommendation.title: Keep reaction-specific report
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical reaction add/remove Socket Mode failure and request redacted live current-main envelope plus gateway trace proof before coding.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans Slack monitor filtering, channel delivery, and current plugin boundary history where steipete has the strongest sampled ownership signal.
